newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran self-sufficient in building dams - minister.
newsitem.headline: Iran self-sufficient in building dams - minister.

text.p: Iran has achieved self-sufficiency in building dams and manufacturing electricity facilities, Energy Minister Bijan Namdar Zanganeh was quoted on Monday as saying.
Iran is already producing 200 kilowatt (kw) transformers and the manufacture of 400 kw transformers is under way, he said in an interview published in the Persian daily Iran.
These would meet domestic needs and also be exported, he said.
Zanganeh said plans had been made for more than 95 percent of electricity generating equipment to be produced in Iran.
In the near future, almost all equipment required by hydropower stations would be made in the country.

Zanganeh said Iran was providing electricity to the autonomous republic of Nakhichevan and to Turkey. Implementation of a plan for transferring electricity to Turkmenistan and Armenia was also being studied.
